title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
lede: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to stop server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries while it checks that regional partners comply with U.S. export rules, the Wall Street Journal reports.

points: Partners including Dell and Super Micro were told to hold shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia.
The pause has no stated end date.
Chinese companies had been renting Nvidia compute remotely from data centers in those countries until the Commerce Department shut that route this month.
The Institute for Progress estimates such remote facilities provide about 24% of China's AI computing power.

sections.text: Server supply to Southeast Asian data centers now waits on export compliance checks, which can delay or tighten GPU capacity for anyone building on infrastructure hosted there.
